purpose: Track editorial/source dependence so repeated transcriptions are not counted as independent witnesses.

lineages.independence_rule: Alternative presentations/readings in one publication are not independent ancient witnesses.

lineages.members: all records with authority Wikipedia contributors
lineages.independence_rule: Secondary compilation is not independent epigraphic confirmation.
Classification can be retained as attributed scholarship but not converted into project observation without direct lawful source inspection.
Publication-number concordance is not reading independence.

rules: Never infer independent_witness_count from number of records.
Keep source assertion, project classification and expert adjudication separate.
Physical-object observation outranks derivative repetition only when lawfully inspected and explicitly recorded.
